category_title: Students exhibiting off-task 'silly' behavior and peer-directed inappropriate gestures
scenario_title: Close physical proximity during group music activities
minimal_context: Sammy is participating in a teacher-directed group music activity while seated in a tightly packed front row.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please take your seats in the front row so we can begin our group music activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits down very close to the student next to him and starts making silly clicking noises) Click, click, click.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get ready to listen to the music.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an inappropriate hand gesture toward the peer sitting next to him) I don't want to sit here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Bumps shoulders with the peer due to the tight seating) Get away from me! (Starts making loud siren noises and talking inappropriately over the music) WEE-WOO WEE-WOO!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please take your seats in the front row so we can begin our group music activity.

STUDENT: (Sits down very close to the student next to him and starts making silly clicking noises) Click, click, click.

TUTOR: Let's get ready to listen to the music.

STUDENT: (Makes an inappropriate hand gesture toward the peer sitting next to him) I don't want to sit here.

TUTOR: Please focus on the activity.

STUDENT: (Bumps shoulders with the peer due to the tight seating) Get away from me! (Starts making loud siren noises and talking inappropriately over the music) WEE-WOO WEE-WOO!
